destination.name: Anji
destination.tagline: A county of bamboo hills, lakes and waterfall gorges in northern Zhejiang
destination.description: Anji is a county known as China's bamboo town, where hills of bamboo cover the Tianhuangping area, a film location for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon. The Bamboo Exposition Park and exhibits on bamboo culture sit in the county seat. Jiangnan Tianchi and Canglong Baipu offer lakeside paths and a waterfall gorge. Yucun is the village where the 'green mountains are gold' saying began, and Yunshang, at 1,168 m, has a ski area in snow season.
whyVisit: Try the ski slopes and cliff swings

goodToKnow.title: Check snow before skiing
goodToKnow.detail: Yunshang's ski area, at 1,168 m, runs only in snow season, so check conditions before you go.

goodToKnow.title: Pack a layer for the hills
goodToKnow.detail: Yunshang sits at 1,168 m, well above the lowlands, so it is cooler there than in the county seat.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Clear days suit hill walks in {months}. The ski area runs in snow season.
